key_requirements: Supplements GDPR, national derogations, Law Enforcement Directive rules, supervisory powers
deceased_data: Protected: data subject's consent valid for life and 10 years after death (20 if minor); otherwise heirs' consent needed (§ 9)
research_exemption: Scientific/historical research and official statistics without consent, mainly pseudonymised, with safeguards (§ 6)
genetic_data: Special category under art. 9 GDPR; gene donor data governed by Human Genes Research Act (IGUS), § 9 PDPA not applied to deceased gene donors (IGUS § 1(5))
notes: Fines via misdemeanour procedure; Nov 2023 Penal Code change lifted the earlier cap
